input.subject: Linden Yard - Notice of delay and additional cost - ASI-07 duct shaft revisions
input.body: Priya, please accept this letter as Polar Mechanical's written notice under Subcontract Section 9.3 of delay and additional cost arising from ASI-07 (issued 9/24), which enlarged the duct shaft at Unit Stack 07 after our ductwork shop drawings were approved on 9/15 against Rev 2. Approximately 40% of the Stack 07 duct for L2-L4 is already fabricated to the prior size. We have stopped installation at Stack 07 pending RFI 43. We reserve our right to claim time and cost; pricing will follow within 10 days. - Sandra Kim, Polar Mechanical

facts.quote: please accept this letter as Polar Mechanical's written notice under Subcontract Section 9.3 of delay and additional cost arising from ASI-07
